feed.title: AgentKit Drawer: free guides for AI coding agents
feed.subtitle: Short how-tos for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, Windsurf rules, Codex and agent system prompts.

entry.title: Free directory of agent kits and MCP setups
entry.summary: Hand-picked agent kits, Cursor rules, CLAUDE.md templates, Claude Code plugins and MCP setups. Twenty entries, each with a verified URL. No invented stats.

entry.title: AGENTS.md open format: a README for coding agents
entry.summary: What the AGENTS.md format is, who should write one, and how a one-file AgentKit pack differs from the empty convention.

entry.title: awesome-cursorrules: community Cursor .mdc files
entry.summary: PatrickJS's public Cursor rules collection: what the .mdc dump is good for, where quality slips, and how it differs from a scoped Next.js pack.

entry.title: Cursor project rules docs: .mdc frontmatter explained
entry.summary: Official Cursor documentation for .cursor/rules: alwaysApply, globs, and why a plain .md file is ignored. Not a kit, still the source of truth.

entry.title: awesome-claude-code: curated Claude Code resources
entry.summary: hesreallyhim's curated Claude Code list: skills, hooks, CLAUDE.md links and official docs. Useful for discovery, not a drop-in kit.

entry.title: Claude Code Templates: npx agents, hooks and MCP
entry.summary: davila7's Claude Code Templates (aitmpl.com): a large installable catalog. Handy for browsing, easy to over-install.

entry.title: Superpowers: Claude Code skills for TDD and plans
entry.summary: obra/superpowers is a MIT-licensed Claude Code plugin for brainstorming, plans, TDD and review. Strong discipline, heavy for a spike.

entry.title: Anthropic Agent Skills: official SKILL.md examples
entry.summary: anthropics/skills is the official Agent Skills repo: a template, examples, and document skills that are source-available, not all Apache 2.0.

entry.title: Claude plugins official: Anthropic's marketplace repo
entry.summary: anthropics/claude-plugins-official lists internal and partner plugins. Anthropic says it cannot verify third-party MCP inside them.

entry.title: wshobson/agents: multi-harness plugins and skills
entry.summary: A MIT marketplace of plugins, agents and skills that install into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other harnesses. Broad, easy to over-enable.

entry.title: BMad Method: agile skills for AI coding agents
entry.summary: bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD turns planning and delivery into named skills for Claude Code and Cursor. Powerful, currently split across v6 and preview v7.

entry.title: houshuang Claude Code plugins: session-tested hooks
entry.summary: houshuang/awesome-claude-code is a plugin marketplace of hooks, skills and commands the author actually used. Some items are already superseded.

entry.title: Context7 MCP: current docs for coding agents
entry.summary: Upstash Context7 fetches version-specific library docs for agents via MCP or a CLI skill. It does not write your project rules.

entry.title: Playwright MCP: accessibility-tree browser tools
entry.summary: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP gives agents structured browser tools. The README also steers coding agents toward CLI + skills for token cost.

entry.title: GitHub MCP Server: official issues, PRs and Actions
entry.summary: github/github-mcp-server is GitHub's official MCP. Hosted or local, OAuth or PAT. Use read-only unless the agent should open PRs.

entry.title: Stripe MCP: official API tools for coding agents
entry.summary: Stripe's hosted MCP at mcp.stripe.com. OAuth or Agent-tagged keys. Useful for API truth; it will not fix a webhook that trusts /success.

entry.title: Supabase MCP: official project tools for agents
entry.summary: supabase/mcp connects Cursor or Claude to a Supabase project. Use read_only=true. It does not replace RLS rules in your migrations.

entry.title: awesome-mcp-servers: community MCP server index
entry.summary: punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers is a MIT list of MCP servers. Use it to discover official endpoints, then verify the repo you install.

entry.title: Spec Kit: spec-driven process for coding agents
entry.summary: github/spec-kit installs spec, plan and implement workflows into many coding agents. Process tooling, not a stack rules pack.

entry.title: FastMCP: Python framework for MCP servers
entry.summary: jlowin/fastmcp, now PrefectHQ/fastmcp: decorate a Python function and get an MCP server. For builders, not a CLAUDE.md pack.

entry.title: MCP reference servers: official educational examples
entry.summary: modelcontextprotocol/servers now holds a small set of reference MCP servers. The README says they are educational, not production-ready.

entry.title: Stop AI agents creating Supabase tables without RLS
entry.summary: AI coding agents create Supabase tables with RLS off. Enable RLS in the same migration, write per-command policies, and never disable RLS to make a query work.

entry.title: Don't grant Stripe access on /success: verify webhooks
entry.summary: AI agents grant paid access on the Stripe /success page. Fulfill from a verified webhook, handle duplicate events, and never trust the redirect.

entry.title: Blocking calls in FastAPI async def: what AI agents miss
entry.summary: AI agents put requests, time.sleep and sync SQLAlchemy inside FastAPI async def. That blocks the event loop. Use await, def routes, or run_in_threadpool.

entry.title: Claude Code Stop hook that runs tests (exit 2 blocks)
entry.summary: A Claude Code Stop hook that runs your test suite before the agent finishes. Exit 2 keeps it working; check stop_hook_active so the hook cannot loop.

entry.title: Claude Code hooks examples: 7 copy-paste settings.json hooks
entry.summary: Copy-paste Claude Code hooks for settings.json: auto-format, protect .env, block rm -rf, desktop alerts, context after /compact, tests before Stop.

entry.title: Cursor rules for Python: AGENTS.md template
entry.summary: A Python Cursor rules template: AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules for venv, pytest, type hints, no secrets, plan-first. How it differs from the FastAPI kit.

entry.summary: An AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules setup for FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 + Pydantic v2 that stops AI agents from skipping ownership checks, hand-waving migrations and mocking the database. Free .mdc rule.

entry.summary: A copy-paste AGENTS.md template for OpenAI Codex CLI. What Codex reads, how nested files and AGENTS.override.md work, and how it differs from CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules.

entry.summary: How to set up Claude Code subagents in .claude/agents, PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop hooks in settings.json, and slash commands. Free hook that blocks rm -rf and force-push.

entry.summary: Clear comparison of AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor .cursor/rules, and Windsurf .windsurf/rules. One source of truth, thin tool-specific files, no duplicated rules.

entry.summary: How to set up Windsurf rules with .windsurf/rules files and activation modes, plus a free row-level-security rule for Next.js + Supabase you can drop in today.

entry.summary: A copy-paste CLAUDE.md template for Claude Code: project facts, commands, hard rules and a plan-first workflow, plus a free guardrails snippet that also works in AGENTS.md.

entry.title: System prompt templates for AI agents: researcher, PR reviewer, support triage
entry.summary: Production-style system prompt templates for AI agents, with tool schemas, guardrails, prompt-injection defense and eval cases. Free guardrail snippet.

entry.title: AGENTS.md for Godot 4: rules that keep AI agents from wrecking your scene tree
entry.summary: An AGENTS.md template for Godot 4 and typed GDScript. Keeps Cursor, Claude Code and Codex on scope during game jams. Free copy-paste file.

entry.title: AGENTS.md template for game modding (2026): Minecraft, Godot, Unity mods and tools
entry.summary: Free MIT AGENTS.md for AI coding agents on game mods and small game tools: pin the game version, patch via hooks not vanilla files, protect saves, stay mod-compatible.
